_comment: Display labels and AI-fallback descriptions for magazine subcategories (the slugs + keywords live in the magazine_taxonomy table). Read by the frontend (src/lib/subcategories.ts) and the engine (mounted read-only at /app/subcategories.json). Slugs not listed here are shown humanized ("climate-change" -> "Climate Change").

security-attacks.label: Security & Attacks
security-attacks.description: Cybersecurity: breaches, ransomware, malware, phishing, vulnerabilities and patches, nation-state hacking, scams, plus attacks on AI systems (jailbreaks, prompt injection, data theft through AI tools).

safety-risk.label: AI Safety & Risk
safety-risk.description: AI alignment, rogue or misbehaving AI agents, safety research and warnings, models withheld as too dangerous, existential risk.

politics-policy.label: Politics & Policy
politics-policy.description: Government, regulation, legislation, courts and lawsuits involving government or copyright, military and defense use of AI, international AI policy.

chips-hardware.label: Chips, Hardware & Data Centers
chips-hardware.description: GPUs, chips, servers, data centers, power and energy for AI, robotics hardware, devices and workstations.

reviews.label: Reviews & Hands-On
reviews.description: Reviews, tests, comparisons, hands-on impressions, tutorials, how-to guides and tips.

ai-companies.label: AI Companies & Industry
ai-companies.description: Business news about AI companies: funding, valuations, IPOs, acquisitions, partnerships, revenue, pricing, executives, hiring and departures, strategy.

models-research.label: Models & Research
models-research.description: New or updated AI models, benchmarks, model capabilities, research papers, discoveries made with AI, training techniques.

tools-agents.label: Tools & Agents
tools-agents.description: AI products, apps and features, coding assistants, agent harnesses, plugins and extensions, APIs and SDKs, developer tools, product launches.

society-culture.label: Society & Culture
society-culture.description: AI's effect on jobs, education, health, relationships, media, film and art; ethics debates, opinion and essays, everyday-life stories.
